    opt=torch.optim.Adam([w,b],lr=0.05)
    pw=torch.tensor(3.0)
    for it in range(400):
        opt.zero_grad(); l=torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(Xn@w+b,Y,pos_weight=pw)+1e-4*(w**2).sum(); l.backward(); opt.step()
    with torch.no_grad():
        s=(Xn@w+b).reshape(hi-lo,-1)
        f=(s>0).numpy()
        rec=[round(f[j][y].mean(),2) for j in range(hi-lo)]; ff=[round(f[j][~y].mean(),3) for j in range(hi-lo)]
        print(L,lo,hi,'recall',rec,'ff',ff,'any-ff',round(f.any(0)[~y].mean(),3),'any-rec',round(f.any(0)[y].mean(),3))
    W=(w/sd).detach().numpy(); B=float(b-(w*mu/sd).sum())
    np.save(f'p_{L}_{lo}_{hi}.npy',np.append(W,B).astype(np.float32))
